messages:
olivia (AcmeHealth): hey team, stuck on onboarding — our devs keep getting 401 when calling /v1/generate with the key you provisioned. tried curl + node SDK, same result. can someone check?

jess (support): hi olivia — sorry about that. can you paste the project id you used and the exact error body? pls redact the key.

olivia (AcmeHealth): project: acme-prod (proj-acme-42). error body: `{ \"error\": { \"message\": \"Invalid API key\", \"code\": \"unauthenticated\" } }`

jess (support): thanks. two quick checks: 1) can you confirm the key prefix (eg sk-abc123) and 2) are you using the project header X-Redwood-Project or the project embedded in the key?

olivia (AcmeHealth): key prefix is sk-p8x... we added `X-Redwood-Project: proj-acme-42` header and still 401.

arjun (eng): pinging this thread — curious if key has correct scope. sometimes onboarding flow issues give keys only admin:user scope and not inference. jess can you paste the key id (prefix only) & i'll check the auth service logs.

jess (support): prefix sk-p8x... copying to secure channel and requesting key metadata. deploying quick repro to see 401.

deploy-bot: API key lookup: key=sk-p8x..., created=2026-02-07T18:12:03Z, assigned_project=proj-user-default-901, scopes=[user:read] \n\njess (support): oh — key is assigned to proj-user-default-901 and only has user:read. that explains 401 for inference endpoints. not a customer error.

olivia (AcmeHealth): how did that happen? the onboarding flow should create a project-scoped key for proj-acme-42.

arjun (eng): quick hypothesis: the SSO provisioning job raced with our project creation script. if the job sees no project for the new account it attaches to a fallback personal project and issues a minimal-scope key. i'll escalate to oncall to confirm. @mariam can you take a look at the provisioning logs?

mariam (oncall): looking now — pulling logs for acct acmehealth (acct-1032). found this span: `onboard-service: create_project -> create_key` — key created before project write confirmation due to missing commit barrier. log excerpt: `key_service: created key sk-p8x... assigned_project=proj-user-default-901`. filing ENG ticket.

arjun (eng): thanks — filing ENG-1198: onboarding race causes keys to be issued to fallback project + missing inference scope. impact: customers who hit the race get 401s. mitigation: support can regenerate a key with correct scopes and attach to the intended project, and we'll push a quick fix to add a barrier.

jess (support): olivia — i can create a new key for you immediately with inference scope and attach to proj-acme-42, or if you prefer we can ask eng to move the existing key. which do you prefer?

olivia (AcmeHealth): please create a new key so we can continue testing. moving sounds fine too but faster is better.

jess (support): creating new key now.

deploy-bot: API key created: key=sk-r9m..., created=2026-02-07T19:02:10Z, assigned_project=proj-acme-42, scopes=[inference, embeddings, user:read]

jess (support): OK new key sk-r9m... created and bound to proj-acme-42. olivia, try the same curl but with the new key. here's a quick repro curl we ran locally that returned 200:```\ncurl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-r9m...\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-small\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'\n```\n\nlocal response (truncated): `HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n{ \"id\": \"resp-...\", \"output\": \"hello\" }`

olivia (AcmeHealth): tested — works now, thanks! :white_check_mark: any action for us?

jess (support): none on your side. i'll keep this thread updated. i've opened a support ticket SUP-2249 and linked ENG-1198. mitigation steps: 1) regenerating key for affected accounts, 2) temporary manual audit of new onboarding keys created in last 24h, 3) fastfix to block key issuance until project creation confirmation.

arjun (eng): timeline: will push barrier fix to staging today, prod early next week after smoke tests. long-term: make project id explicit in key creation workflow so race can't assign fallback.

mariam (oncall): added monitoring alert to detect keys created with fallback project and missing inference scope. alert: onboarding-key-race (severity=warning)

sam (cs): looping in account team to follow up with AcmeHealth and confirm no further blocked devs. sam -> olivia: i'll send next steps and confirmation email.

jess (support): closing this thread as resolved for the customer. will follow up in SUP-2249 with ENG-1198 progress. thanks everyone.

olivia (AcmeHealth): really appreciate the fast turnaround, thanks jess + team!

mariam (oncall): noted for postmortem.

jess (support): :thumbsup:
